final_answer:
The time required is **5 minutes**. 

Here's the reasoning:  
If 5 machines take 5 minutes to make 5 widgets, each machine produces 1 widget in 5 minutes. This means the production rate per machine is 1 widget every 5 minutes. When you scale up to 100 machines, each machine still produces 1 widget in 5 minutes. Therefore, 100 machines will produce 100 widgets in the same 5 minutes, as all machines work simultaneously and independently. The time does not change because the ratio of machines to widgets remains constant.
